Symmetrised subspace z in the shape preservation_matrix_test() reads

Source: R/subspace.R
as_preservation_matrix.Rd

preservation_matrix_test() reads reference, test and Zsummary_std from a classification table. This returns one row per unordered species pair with Zsummary_std set to the mean of the two directed z of subspace_preservation(), so the trait test runs on the partition-free statistic unchanged; the unit is then the species pair, not the module-direction.

as_preservation_matrix(x)

Arguments

x

A subspace_preservation object.

Value

Data frame with columns reference, test and Zsummary_std.

See also

subspace_preservation(), preservation_matrix_test()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
sp <- subspace_preservation(nets, hog_map, K = 100L)
preservation_matrix_test(as_preservation_matrix(sp), group, block = genus)
} # }
